smtp_server.description: IP address or name of the SMTP mail server to test. Enclose in [] for non-standard ports, precede with '+' for per-connection DNS lookup, separate multiple with commas for round-robin.

user_list_file.description: Path to a file containing a list of user email addresses for the To: field.

sender_list_file.description: Path to a file containing a list of sender email addresses for the From: field. Defaults to user_list_file if not specified.

max_message_size.description: Maximum size of the message body in Kilobytes. Specify 0 for just headers.

min_message_size.description: Minimum size of the message body in Kilobytes.

threads.description: Number of threads to create. This is created per server address if multiple are specified.

messages_per_connection.description: Number of messages to send per connection. -1 for indefinite. 0 to disconnect immediately.

messages_per_minute.description: Limit throughput in messages per minute. 0 for effectively unlimited (24000).

ssl_percentage.description: Percentage of connections that use TLS/SSL. 0 for no SSL, 100 for always SSL.

use_lmtp.description: If true, use LMTP protocol instead of SMTP.

local_address.description: Local IP address(es) to use for outbound connections. Same format as remote address.

log_all.description: If true, turn on all logging including all message data received.

breakage_mode.description: Breakage simulation mode. 'netscape' avoids leading spaces in subjects. 'nonetscape' adds extra spaces.

debug_file_base.description: Base path for debugging IO files. Threads create files with ':' and thread number appended. Empty string disables this.
